cases.prompt: Repack a batch of canonical protein poses on the available device without changing sequence identities. Keep a supplied block mask fixed, use a conservative packing chunk size of 10, and verify the output before reporting runtime and peak memory.
expected_behavior: Uses PackerTask.restrict_to_repacking() and the standard conformer samplers
Applies disable_packing_by_block_mask() to the supplied mask
Does not require CUDA graph capture for compact packing memory
Verifies finite output and unchanged fixed blocks and identities
